text: why does it compile right when the app starts. it causes the app to start and immediately be frozen
resolution: App auto-compiled right at startup → instantly frozen. The req_1866 mount-guard skipped only the first effect run, but on boot the world DATA loads a beat later (worldRev/placements/previewWorld go empty→populated), re-running the auto-compile effect which read the load as an edit and baked immediately. Replaced the single-run guard with a GRACE WINDOW (AUTO_COMPILE_GRACE_MS=4s) reset on every (re)mount and map switch: auto-compile is suppressed until the settling window passes, so neither boot nor a hot reload auto-bakes — only a genuine edit AFTER the window does. Manual Compile + the persisted toggle (req_1865) unaffected. TSX-only, hot-reloads. Committed a3215783d; completes the auto-compile fix line (req_1865 toggle 0d736c625, req_1866 mount-guard 8e59816ae, this grace window).
